# What's the "no tax on tips" and "no tax on overtime" deduction worth?

> Free calculator for the federal 'no tax on tips' and 'no tax on overtime' deductions (2025-2028): applies the $25,000 tip cap, the $12,500/$25,000 overtime cap, and the shared MAGI phase-out, and computes the overtime deduction's easy-to-miss half-time-premium-only rule. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
